posts.text:
Twenty-five years ago, America changed forever.

Today, Louisiana remembers five sons and daughters whose lives were stolen on September 11, 2001:

Elizabeth Ann “Betty” Farmer, 62.
Retired U.S. Air Force Lt. Col. Robert Joseph Hymel, 55.
U.S. Navy Lt. Michael Scott Lamana, 31.
Louis Calvin Williams III, 53.
Kevin Wayne Yokum, 27.

Twenty-five years later, we still remember their names and we will never forget.

God bless their families and the United States of America.
posts.summary: Honors 9/11 victims, commemorates loss to terrorism
